title: Possibilities and limitations of AFM-IR to detect nanoplastic particles in the atmosphere
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1910-1925
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01155H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nico Kummer, Stefan Horender, Tero S. Kulmala, Konstantina Vasilatou, Christoph Hueglin, Ralf Kaegi
Atomic force microscopy infrared spectroscopy provides sufficient spatial resolution and chemical specificity to identify nanoplastics. Application of the technique to environmental samples is restricted by high (particle-based) detection limits.
